regime_context: Hong Kong detector shows a NON-directional rotation landscape: eligible themes are narrow (4 of 17), the leader (Diversified Miners) is NOT trend-gate eligible, and the highest-score eligible theme (Banks) has mixed hurst with low durability. Absolute-trend gate is validated for risk control on this market, so only four themes pass the staying-power filter; everything else is display-only attention flow. No scorable ETF proxy exists for any eligible theme, so all leans are unscorable and conviction must be low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks (H + HK) takes confirmed leadership from Diversified Miners. The migration of the rotation leader from non-eligible Miners to eligible Banks would be worth noting; I'm watching for Banks to hold rank 1 or 2 among eligible themes while Diversified Miners' score drops below the Banks score.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the highest-scored theme that clears the ONLY validated leg — the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true, durability_bar 0.68, the strongest durability among eligible names). Breadth of 0.769 shows the theme is broadly participating, not a single-name squeeze. Hurst is mixed, so this is a staying-power/risk-control lean, not a momentum call.
evidence: eligible=true — passes absolute-trend gate (validated risk-control leg)
rank 2 with score 1.185 — leadership attention without being a reflexive leader
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst means the trend is not clean; Banks could chop sideways, and high-dividend blue chips (also eligible) offer comparable staying-power with lower attention risk.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) theme breadth drops below 0.3 before the check-by date and the theme fails to hold its relative rank versus high-dividend blue chips.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Second-highest eligible score (0.823) with a clean trend hurst and adequate durability (0.55). Passing the trend gate is the only validated edge, and this theme pairs that with a trend-tag that is unambiguously directional — a pure staying-power lean with no momentum claim.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend — cleanest trend among eligible themes
theses.dissent: Low breadth (0.25) means the theme can be dominated by one or two names; a single high-dividend constituent wobble could drag the whole theme despite the gate.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips loses eligible status before the check-by date (trend gate flips false) while Banks and Conglomerates remain eligible.

theses.dissent: Breadth of 0.0 means there is effectively no multi-name participation to confirm the theme; zero breadth makes this the weakest eligible case and most exposed to a single-name event.
